gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Funky and loose on top, then a wide-open middle zone below. Noto Sans Coptic lets its s and c mouths stay uncrowded, which is the sharpest turn from Groovy's closed, pipe-cleaner joins.

gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Noto Sans Devanagari opens with a g whose lower curve stays unclosed and a compact skyline. Groovy's round letters, drawn like bent wire, hang above, and Noto Sans Devanagari then keeps the plain sans text quiet beneath them.

gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan runs large in the lowercase, with terminals that never pinch shut. But if Groovy were shrunk small, its zero-modulation line would lose its fun against that sans.
